title: Relocation Guarantee Price Schedule for Free Night Awards Walked Nights
content:
The award chart's standard-season prices by category are those of the Ashbury Rewards award chart. A category's season step is the gap between its neighbouring seasons on that chart; its off-peak price is its standard-season price less one season step and its peak-season price its standard-season price plus one season step.

| Category | Off-peak | Standard season | Peak season | Season step |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 5000 | 7500 | 10000 | 2500 |
| 2 | 10000 | 12500 | 15000 | 2500 |
| 3 | 15000 | 17500 | 20000 | 2500 |
| 4 | 20000 | 25000 | 30000 | 5000 |
| 5 | 30000 | 35000 | 40000 | 5000 |
| 6 | 40000 | 45000 | 50000 | 5000 |
| 7 | 50000 | 60000 | 70000 | 10000 |
| 8 | 70000 | 85000 | 100000 | 15000 |

**Price clause.** The walked-night protected price stated on the return record of one of the Free Night Awards coming back from a reservation the hotel relocated is the award-chart price of the walked night for the category and season recorded on the relocated reservation, in whole points. The walked-night protected price is never below zero.

The category and the season are the award category and award season recorded on the relocated reservation at booking.

### Worked figures (hypothetical relocated reservations)

| Category and season recorded | Walked-night protected price |
|---|---|
| Category 5, peak | 40000 |
| Category 2, off-peak | 10000 |
| Category 8, standard | 85000 |
